EXTRA-01.note: A payment processor with no seller on the receipt: decline

EXTRA-02.note: The same processor, but the receipt names the seller: create the seller (control)

EXTRA-03.note: A new merchant with nothing on the transaction to support it: decline

EXTRA-04.note: A rename with no sign of the new name anywhere on the transaction: decline

EXTRA-05.note: A merchant from another city that the receipt names in full: move the transaction (control)
